What are the clinic hours?

Our clinics are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Some locations offer extended hours — I can look up a specific clinic if you tell me which one you need.

I was charged twice for the same appointment. What should I do?

I'm sorry to hear that! Duplicate charges are resolved through our billing review process. Please fill out the billing support form at eir-health.example/billing and our team will investigate within 10 business days. If you have your appointment reference number, include it to speed things up.

Can I reschedule my appointment online?

Yes! You can reschedule through the Eir Health citizen portal at portal.eir-health.example. Log in, go to My Appointments, and select Reschedule. If you need help accessing the portal, I can walk you through the steps.

I forgot my portal password.

No problem! Go to portal.eir-health.example and click Forgot password. Enter your registered email and you'll receive a reset link within a few minutes. If you don't receive it, check your spam folder or contact us at support@eir-health.example.

What vaccinations are available at Eir Health clinics?

Our clinics offer seasonal flu vaccines, COVID-19 boosters, travel vaccines, and routine adult immunisations. Availability varies by location. You can book a vaccination appointment through the portal or call your nearest clinic directly.

How do I get a receipt for my last visit?

Receipts are available in the citizen portal under Billing History. You can download or print them from there. If your visit was more than 12 months ago, please contact support@eir-health.example and we'll send it to you directly.

Can I get a referral through the portal?

Referrals are issued by your treating clinician during or after a visit — they can't be requested directly through the portal. If you believe you need a referral, please book an appointment and discuss it with your doctor.

I want to cancel my appointment.

You can cancel through the portal under My Appointments, or by calling the clinic directly. Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a late cancellation fee. Would you like help finding your clinic's contact number?

What is the refund policy?

Citizens can request a billing review through the public support form at eir-health.example/billing. If a duplicate charge or billing error is confirmed, a refund is processed within 10 business days. We don't issue refunds for late cancellations or missed appointments.

How do I update my contact details?

Log in to the citizen portal, go to My Profile, and update your details there. Changes take effect immediately. If you're having trouble accessing the portal, contact us at support@eir-health.example.

Is there a walk-in option?

Yes, most Eir Health clinics accept walk-ins for minor issues, but availability depends on the day and clinic. I recommend calling ahead or checking the portal for real-time wait times. Booking in advance guarantees your slot.

My billing address is wrong on the invoice.

You can update your billing address in the portal under My Profile. For invoices already issued with the wrong address, please contact support@eir-health.example and include your invoice number — we'll reissue it with the correct details.

Do you offer telehealth appointments?
Yes, Eir Health offers telehealth consultations for many services. You can book a video appointment through the portal the same way as an in-person visit — just select Online as the appointment type.

I have a question about my child's vaccination record.

Vaccination records for dependants are accessible through the portal under Family Health Records, provided you have guardianship access set up. If you haven't linked your child's records yet, contact your nearest clinic with proof of guardianship.

Can I pay my bill by bank transfer?
Yes, bank transfer is one of the accepted payment methods. Bank details are printed on your invoice. Please include your invoice number as the payment reference so we can match it correctly.

How long does it take to get an appointment?

Routine appointments are usually available within 3 to 5 business days. Urgent consultations can often be booked the same day — I'd recommend calling the clinic directly for urgent needs. Telehealth slots are also often available sooner.

I never received my appointment confirmation email.

Confirmation emails are sent immediately after booking. Please check your spam folder. If it's not there, log in to the portal — your appointment will be listed under My Appointments even if the email didn't arrive. You can also resend the confirmation from there.

What documents do I need to bring to my first appointment?

Please bring a valid photo ID, your health insurance card if applicable, and any relevant medical records or referral letters. If you have a health card number, bring that too. Arriving 10 minutes early helps with check-in.

Is my data safe with Eir Health?

Yes. Eir Health is fully compliant with GDPR and national health data regulations. Your personal and health data is encrypted, access-controlled, and never shared with third parties without your consent. You can view our privacy policy at eir-health.example/privacy.

Can I book an appointment for someone else?

Yes, you can book on behalf of a family member or dependent if you have guardianship or proxy access set up in the portal. Visit My Profile and add them under Family Members. If you need help setting this up, contact support.

What happens if I miss my appointment?

A missed appointment without 24-hour notice may incur a late cancellation fee. You can reschedule at no charge if you cancel in advance. If you had an emergency, please contact support@eir-health.example and we'll review the charge.

How do I get my test results?

Test results are posted to the portal under Health Records, usually within 3 to 7 business days of the test. Your clinician will also follow up if there's anything requiring attention. If your results haven't appeared after 7 days, contact your clinic directly.

Yes, please update your address in the portal under My Profile as soon as possible. This ensures invoices, appointment letters, and any postal communications reach you correctly.

Yes, Eir Health works with most major private health insurers. At the time of booking, select your insurer from the list. If your insurer isn't listed, contact support and we'll check coverage manually.

General consultation fees vary by clinic and appointment type. Standard in-person consultations start from 65 EUR. Telehealth consultations are typically 45 EUR. Exact fees are shown at the time of booking. Insurance may cover part or all of the cost.
